designDecisions: FullHtmlReplaceHead mode used due to fill-html-head.mjs radius semantic mapping failure. Head infrastructure manually composed with inline CSS variables, Tailwind v4 @theme inline bridge, semantic-token-fallback, Lucide CDN, and [data-icon] mask infrastructure. Dark theme active via html class='dark'. Navigation follows Apple webbar pattern (44-48px dark bar, pill links). Cards follow Library card pattern (var(--card) bg, 1px solid var(--border), var(--radius) corners, shadow-sm hover). Buttons follow pill pattern with var(--primary) fill. Input follows search field pattern with var(--background-800) dark bg and var(--border) border. Product grid uses 3-column responsive layout. Trust signals use feature-stripe pattern from UI Kit.
qualityRisks: fill-html-head.mjs could not generate head due to missing --apple-radius-sm/md/lg semantic aliases in library CSS; head was manually constructed. Radius alias issue should be resolved at library level for future pages.
headManagementEvidence: Full HTML written first, then head infrastructure manually constructed with CSS variables, Tailwind CDN, Lucide CDN, @theme inline bridge, semantic-token-fallback, and [data-icon] mask rules. fill-html-head.mjs --replace-head failed due to missing radius semantic mappings; head built manually instead.

designIntentEvidence.visualNorthStarApplied: Dark cinematic audio platform with premium Apple-inspired restraint. Hero section uses full-bleed waveform image with dark overlay. Brand blue (#007aff via var(--primary)) used exclusively for CTAs and active states.
designIntentEvidence.compositionPatternUsed: Full-screen hero + content sections with alternating dark/darker backgrounds
designIntentEvidence.antiSlopCheck: No rainbow gradients, no icon tile wall, no neon glow. Dark monotone with single brand hue.

interactionStates.forms: default state rendered; focus/hover can be handled via JS enhancement

headingCtaEvidence.headingPolicy: All headings are short noun phrases: '释放你的音乐灵感' (8 CJK chars), '热门采样包' (5 chars), '创作者工具' (5 chars), '声浪插件'/'云端同步'/'AI 推荐' (4 chars each), '正版授权'/'永久拥有'/'随时取消' (4 chars each). No sentence headings.
headingCtaEvidence.ctaPolicy: CTA labels are short: '立即体验' (4 chars), '免费体验' (4 chars), '查看全部' (4 chars), '登录' (2 chars). Genre pills are 2 CJK chars each.

motionEvidence: Card hover elevation (translateY -2px + shadow step) provides subtle depth feedback. CTA buttons use brightness filter on hover. Nav links show background highlight on hover.

headCommandEvidence.headCommandUsed: fill-html-head.mjs failed due to missing radius semantic aliases in library CSS; head infrastructure was manually constructed

privateRegionsGenerated: main content (nav, hero, packs, tools, trust, footer)
